# KPI card

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures), [Not for](#not-for).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Single-metric card: label, big value, up to two comparison pills, optional attainment, shape-only line/area/column sparkline with last observed value labelled. Type `kpi`.

## Use cases

- Headline metric with trend
- Metric against PY and plan
- Dashboard tile

## Chart IDs

One form; its chart ID is `kpi`.

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "kpi",
  "data": { "label": "Revenue", "value": 120, "delta": { "vs": 100, "scenario": "PY" } },
  "options": { "unit": "$k", "title": "Revenue is $20k above prior year", "source": "Illustrative data" }
}
```

## Data

A `cell` is a number, null or a value object; see [Value cell](options.md#value-cell).

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | string | yes | Name of the metric displayed above the main value. |
| value | number | yes | Main metric value in its original units. |
| format | string |  | Format-by-example for the main metric and absolute comparison values (a % example expects percent units: 3.53 for 3.53%). |
| delta | object |  | Single scenario comparison; cannot be combined with compare. |
| delta.vs | number | yes | Reference value subtracted from the main metric. |
| delta.scenario | string |  | AC, PY, PL, FC (or ACT, BUD, FCST). Code of the comparison baseline; a baseline with its own name, such as a month, goes in compare[].label instead. |
| delta.direction | string |  | Whether an increase from the reference is favorable. neutral prints ordinary ink without a judgment; omission keeps higherIsBetter. One of `'higherIsBetter'`, `'lowerIsBetter'`, `'neutral'`. |
| delta.mode | string |  | Display absolute change, relative change, or both. Defaults to relative. A zero or negative vs shows the absolute change with a ref-nonpositive warning; under a percent format the absolute change prints in pp. One of `'absolute'`, `'relative'`, `'both'`. |
| compare | array |  | One or two named comparisons below the metric; cannot be combined with delta. An empty compare list is the same as none. |
| compare[].vs | number | yes | Reference value for this named comparison. |
| compare[].label | string | yes | Visible name of this comparison baseline. |
| compare[].direction | string |  | Whether an increase from this reference is favorable. neutral prints ordinary ink without a judgment; omission keeps higherIsBetter. One of `'higherIsBetter'`, `'lowerIsBetter'`, `'neutral'`. |
| compare[].mode | string |  | Display absolute change, relative change, or both. Defaults to both. A zero or negative vs shows the absolute change with a ref-nonpositive warning; under a percent format the absolute change prints in pp. One of `'absolute'`, `'relative'`, `'both'`. |
| attainment | object |  | Ratio of the main value to a named target, displayed as attainment. |
| attainment.vs | number | yes | Target value used as the attainment denominator. |
| attainment.label | string | yes | Visible name of the attainment target. |
| attainment.tone | string |  | Attainment tone. Omitted, it is the tone of the comparison against the same reference, else neutral. One of `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'neutral'`. |
| bands | array |  | Qualitative bands for the main value, ascending by `to`. The band that holds the value sets the tone of the main value only; comparison tones stay separate. A band without a tone keeps the plain ink. A band `label` is added to the screen-reader text and the record. |
| bands[].tone | string |  | Semantic band tone. One of `'good'`, `'warn'`, `'bad'`, `'neutral'`. |
| bands[].to | number | yes | Upper endpoint of this band in the value units. |
| bands[].label | string |  | Visible name of this band. |
| note | string |  | Authored caption under the value: the basis, filter or scope the number is true of. Printed as written; the card never composes it. |
| spark | object |  | Small trend chart displayed beneath the KPI comparison content. |
| spark.kind | string | yes | Shape-only sparkline. 'column' is zero-anchored. The last observed value is labelled unless the card's figure already prints it. No axes. One of `'line'`, `'area'`, `'column'`. |
| spark.values | cell[] | yes | Trend observations in chronological order, in the same base units as the main value; the card format labels the last observed value unless it reads the same as the card's figure. A last value 1000 times or more off the main value is refused (spark-scale-mismatch). Missing cells create gaps. |
| spark.labels | array |  | One period name per value, such as 'W1' or 'Jan'. The card prints the first and the last under the spark's ends, so the reader sees the span. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| labels | false \| object | `false` (or another value of its type) |  | False hides comparisons and spark endpoint values. The main number, metric name and authored note remain. total: false explicitly hides the main number. |
| density | string | `'compact'`, `'regular'` | `'regular'` | Card density. 'compact' uses the smaller figure and spark share, and a 280 px default card width instead of 360. An unsized card takes its content height. 'regular' is the default. |
| comparisons | string | `'chip'`, `'text'` |  | How compare[] and attainment are drawn. Omitted, a standalone regular card without a spark draws the steering form: the comparisons as rows of toned text with their names in a column, the attainment as a progress bar with a 100% tick, in one band on a wide card; a grid panel, a compact card, a card with a spark and a card whose height cannot hold the form draw chips. 'chip' tints a chip behind each; 'text' draws each as delta is drawn: text in its tone, no fill, compare entries on one row. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `detailFields`, `categoryLabels`, `valueAxis`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `bandFraction`, `story`, `hatchStrength`, `colorblindSafe`, `rounding`.

## Annotations

This type takes no annotations.

## Sizing

Floor 280 × 28 px; fit `content`.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).

## Not for

Several categories side by side; kpi shows one metric.
